channel.title: New Straits Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from New Straits Times (nst.com.my)

item.title: China executes 4 more accused Myanmar scam centre leaders
item.description: BEIJING: China has executed four leading members of Myanmar-based scam syndicates, a Chinese court said on Monday, the second such announcement in less than a week as Beijing ramps up a crackdown on cross-border telecom fraud.

item.title: Penang local council officer hurt in balloon explosion hospitalised for burn injuries
item.description: GEORGE TOWN: One of two Penang Island City Council (MBPP) enforcement officers injured after a bundle of balloons exploded last night is still being treated at the hospital for burns to both hands and the face.

item.title: Terengganu coach urges patience for World Cup-bound forward Kastaneer
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Terengganu has signed a player who is most likely to go to the World Cup in North America this year, but Gervane Kastaneer has to get used to the M-League first.

item.title: #SHOWBIZ: Actor Pablo Amirul, Dr Hana Rose tie the knot in elegant ceremony
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Actor Pablo Amirul has officially tied the knot with aesthetician Dr Hana Rose, after a single lafaz (vow), at their nikah (solemnisation) ceremony held at The Dove Hall in Jalan Tun Razak, here, earlier today.

item.title: Eco World projects to drive 24pct FY26 growth: CGS International
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Eco World Development Group Bhd’s new projects, such as Eco Business Park (EBP) 7, Eco Botanic 3 and Eco Radiance, should anchor 24 per cent earnings growth in financial year 2026 (FY26), CGS International Securities Malaysia Sdn Bhd said.

item.title: Penang Muda: Decades of river pollution in Kg Selamat must end in this generation
item.description: TASEK GELUGOR: The decades-long river pollution and foul odour in Kampung Selamat here, allegedly caused by pig farming, must not be passed on to future generations.

item.title: Ex-bank sales manager fined RM210,000 over RM211,636 bribes
item.description: MELAKA: A former bank sales manager was fined RM210,000 by the Sessions Court today after pleading guilty to 20 alternative charges of accepting RM211,636 in bribes between May 2018 and September 2022.

item.title: Open burning cases in Terengganu soar over 900pct in January
item.description: KUALA TERENGGANU: Terengganu recorded 121 cases of open burning between January 1 and 31, compared with just 12 cases during the same period last year, said State Fire and Rescue Department director Nor Mahathir Muhamad.

item.title: UK pay rises could pressure inflation, survey shows
item.description: LONDON: British businesses are most likely to plan pay rises this year of between three and 3.49 per cent, according to a survey yesterday.

item.title: IMF chief says global inflation to fall, trade integration is needed
item.description: DUBAI: Global inflation is expected to fall to 3.8 per cent this year and to 3.4 per cent in 2027, helped by softer demand and lower energy prices, the IMF chief said on Monday.
